text.description:
{Centaur's Axe}

This right-handed weapon increases your Attack skill by +2.

{Blackshard of the Dead Knight}

This right-handed weapon increases your Attack skill by +3.

{Greater Gnoll's Flail}

This right-handed weapon increases your Attack skill by +4.

{Ogre's Club of Havoc}

This right-handed weapon increases your Attack skill by +5.

{Sword of Hellfire}

This right-handed weapon increases your Attack skill by +6.

{Shield of the Dwarven Lords}

This left-handed item increases your Defense skill by +2.

{Shield of the Yawning Dead}

This left-handed item increases your Defense skill by +3.

{Buckler of the Gnoll King}

This left-handed item increases your Defense skill by +4.

{Targ of the Rampaging Ogre}

This left-handed item increases your Defense skill by +5.

{Shield of the Damned}

This left-handed item increases your Defense skill by +6.

{Garniture of Interference}

Worn about the neck, this item increases your chance to resist a hostile spell by 5%.

{Surcoat of Counterpoise}

Worn about the shoulders, this item increases your chance to resist a hostile spell by 10%.

{Boots of Polarity}

Worn on the feet, these boots increases your chance to resist a hostile spell by 15%.

{Statesman's Medal}

Worn about the neck, the Statesman's Medal reduces the cost of surrendering by 10%.

{Diplomat's Ring}

Worn on the finger, the Diplomat's Ring reduces the cost of surrendering by 10%.

{Ambassador's Sash}

Worn about the shoulders, the Ambassador's Sash reduces the cost of surrendering by 10%.

{Necklace of Ocean Guidance}

Worn about the neck, this necklace increases your hero's movement rate at sea by 1000 points.

{Spirit of Oppression}

This item negates positive morale during combat for both you and your opponent.

{Hourglass of the Evil Hour}

This item negates positive luck during combat for both you and your opponent.

{Orb of Vulnerability}

During combat, this orb negates natural magic immunities and chances to resist spells of all creatures on the battlefield. Does not affect the limitations on applicability stated in spell descriptions as well as the immunities given by artifacts.

{Sea Captain's Hat}

When worn, this hat increases your movement at sea by 500 points, allows you to summon and destroy boats, and protects you from whirlpools.

{Shackles of War}

When these shackles are wielded in combat between two heroes, neither you nor your opponent may retreat or surrender.

{Armageddon's Blade}

+3 Attack. +3 Defense. +3 Power. +6 Knowledge. Places Expert Armageddon Spell in your hero's spell book. All allied creatures become immune to Armageddon.

{Cloak of the Undead King}

If hero does not have the Necromancy skill the Cloak of the Undead King will raise 30% of the battlefield dead enemies as Skeletons. If hero already has the Necromancy skill then, counting component effects, this cloak  increases the Necromancy skill by 30% and allows to raise stronger undead units. The level of skill determines what type is resurrected.
Basic: Zombies
Advanced: Wights
Expert: Liches

{Elixir of Life}

Counting component effects the Elixir of Life increases health of all units in the Hero's ranks by +4 and additionally gives all living creatures a 25% bonus to their health and gain the ability to regenerate 50 hit points each round.

{Armor of the Damned}

Counting component effects the Armor of the Damned gives hero +3 Attack, +3 Defence, +2 Power, and +2 Knowledge. Casts these spells on expert level at the beginning of combat on all of your opponent's creatures for 50 rounds: Slow, Curse, Weakness, and Misfortune.

{Statue of Legion}

Counting component effects the Statue of Legion increases the growth of level 2/3/4/5/6 creatures by 5/4/3/2/1 correspondingly for the town hero is currently located. Moreover, the statue gives you +50% creature growth for all towns (this counts Castle growth bonus, but does not include flagged structures or other like bonuses).

{Power of the Dragon Father}

Counting component effects the Power of the Dragon Father gives hero +16 to all primary skills, and +1 to morale and luck. The hero's troops become immune to all level 1-4 spells except Dispel.

{Titan's Thunder}

Counting component effects the Titan's Thunder gives hero +9 Attack, +9 Defence, +8 Power, and +8 Knowledge. Gives the hero the Titan's Lightning Bolt spell that causes 600 points of damage and does not cost any spell points. If the hero does not have a spell book, then one will be permanently added.

{Admiral's Hat}

Counting component effects Admiral's Hat increases your movement at sea by 1500 points, allows you to summon and destroy boats, and protects you from whirlpools. Moreover, the hat will remove the Boarding and Unboarding ship penalty, converting the hero’s movement points between Land and Water.

{Bow of the Sharpshooter}

Counting component effects the Bow of the Sharpshooter increases hero Archery skill by 30%. Allows ranged shooters fire projectiles while adjacent to an enemy creature. Removes archery penalty for range or obstacle.

{Wizard's Well}

Regenerates all spell points each day.

{Ring of the Magi}

Counting component effects this ring adds 56 rounds to spell duration.

{Cornucopia}

Counting component effects this item generates +5 Mercury, Sulfur, Crystals, and Gems, each day.
